title: salvia distans
intro: Salvia distans, commonly known as meadow sage or Russian sage, is a perennial herb native to the steppes of Eastern Europe and Central Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Salvia distans are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents may also contribute to its reported antispasmodic and expectorant effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues.
